notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
This update was focused on improving the game messages and explanations so all game mechanics are better described.

Changes:
-All character Tutorial Menus appear automatically at some point during the campaign.
-A Crystal is blocking the way inside the Mine forcing the player to get it, this way it's clearer that those Crystals are game items.
-Mount Kouseki received a small mapping change giving a hint about the way to get the secret chest.
-Jack gives 5 more crystals.
-Jack explains about the Herbs and Mushroom Potion during obligatory dialogs, the player doesn't need to get into his house to discover about this potion.
-All items used during Act 4 are returned to the player when the act is completed.
-After the player has completed Act 4, every time the player decides to enter the desert Haruki will inform the best way to get out of it.
-The Crafting messages give better hints on how long it will take to finish.

None of this adjustments should interfere with saved games, but if something happens, you can contact me through my twitter @JaimePazLopes or here on the Community Hub
Thank you for your suggestions.

notes.title: BIG Update and Game Release
notes.content:
On the last few days, I’ve been working on the game final adjustment before launching. This adjustment has been updated here on Steam. The demo was updated as well.
Principal updates:
      -	Adjustment of game balance: Reduction of the number of battles. Because of that, the money and experience were also adjusted.
      -	Creation of battlebacks. Before the battles weren’t how I wanted. So, I’ve added personalized battlebacks.
      -	More memories. Some memories were added to the game’s first scene when Yori arrives at home. The intention was to better show his relationship with his parents.
None of this adjustments should interfere with saved games, but if something happens, you can contact me through my twitter @JaimePazLopes 
In case you’ve not noticed, the game’s release date has been updated. It’s tomorrow, July 13th!!
Thank you for your suggestions.
Good game tomorrow!
